01 / Cigna Evernorth

ColdFusion-to-Java application migration

Problem
An existing ColdFusion application needed to be migrated to the Java platform within an enterprise healthcare environment.
What I did
I contributed to the migration and to Java web application development, including backend integration, application changes, testing, and support.
Stack
Java Spring Hibernate Maven Git
Result
Application functionality was migrated from ColdFusion to Java. My work included implementing and testing changes within the existing application environment.
02 / Cigna Evernorth

Healthcare APIs and authentication

Problem
Healthcare applications needed server APIs to exchange information with existing systems, alongside application authentication.
What I did
I created APIs for healthcare system integration, worked with FHIR, and developed Spring Security authentication using OAuth2 and OpenID Connect.
Stack
Java Spring Security REST APIs FHIR OAuth2 / OpenID Connect
Result
Implemented healthcare API integration and authentication components. These are related responsibilities from the same role, rather than a claim that every API shared one authentication design.

Stack
Java Python Django Pandas MySQL AWS
Result
Delivered automation tools and a Python REST API framework for these workflows, with AWS integration for storage and data access.
